cockpit_baseline.label: Cockpit current main / v1.3.16 era
cockpit_baseline.evidence_note: Public GitHub release workflow + current CODEX_API_SERVICE_HANDOFF reviewed on 2026-08-19.

capabilities.label: Codex multi-account management
capabilities.notes: HMS account pool exists; real Windows account lifecycle still pending.

capabilities.label: Codex isolated multi-instance
capabilities.notes: HMS has isolated instance/fleet/session layers; target-PC runtime certification pending.

capabilities.label: Hourly/weekly quota + plan recognition
capabilities.notes: HMS has quota history/metadata, but live fidelity across OAuth/PAT/Team remains runtime gap.

capabilities.label: Named local client API keys
capabilities.notes: Digest-only key store; plaintext shown only at creation.

capabilities.label: Per-key model allow/deny + prefix
capabilities.notes: v24 adds model prefix exposure/rewriting plus existing allow/deny.

capabilities.label: Auto/random/single/quota/plan/expiry/custom routing
capabilities.notes: v24 closes current Cockpit routing-mode gap.

capabilities.label: Priority/weight/backup routing
capabilities.notes: Can be overridden per client key.

capabilities.label: Per-key target/account pool
capabilities.notes: HMS extension: each client key can have its own target subset.

capabilities.label: Fresh quota reserve fail-closed
capabilities.notes: Requires real quota metadata feed for production.

capabilities.label: Session affinity + cooldown/failover
capabilities.notes: Affinity is client-key scoped in v24.

capabilities.label: Models/chat/responses/backend Codex generic HTTP surface
capabilities.notes: HMS generic relay covers paths; exact real-Codex compatibility remains target-PC gate.

capabilities.label: Responses WebSocket relay
capabilities.notes: Synthetic handshake/relay/failover PASS.

capabilities.label: Image endpoint compatibility
capabilities.notes: Generic relay exists, but no dedicated image-tool mapping/concurrency scheduler in HMS yet.

capabilities.label: Local CORS preflight
capabilities.notes: Loopback-origin allowlist by default.

capabilities.label: Daily/week/month/all usage by account/model/key
capabilities.notes: Trace-derived analytics; token coverage depends on upstream usage fields.

capabilities.label: Custom model pricing + estimated value
capabilities.notes: No hard-coded possibly stale prices; operator supplies pricing.

capabilities.label: Request ID/account/retry/timing diagnostics
capabilities.notes: HMS also captures TTFT/bytes/protocol telemetry.

capabilities.label: Backup/restore managed Codex profile
capabilities.notes: HMS safety architecture exists but needs explicit Windows runtime proof.

capabilities.label: Session/history visibility repair
capabilities.notes: HMS Session Doctor backs up session metadata and repairs known state_5.sqlite thread provider fields.

capabilities.label: Advanced timeout/retry/stream controls
capabilities.notes: Some Cockpit presets/controls remain richer in UI.

capabilities.label: Proxy fail-closed egress
capabilities.notes: HMS Proxy Fleet is deeper than baseline proxy-url handling.

capabilities.label: Public-IP baseline/drift/quarantine
capabilities.notes: HMS-specific control-plane extension.

capabilities.label: HA + Soak + Policy Kernel
capabilities.notes: HMS-specific reliability extension; Windows soak still pending.

capabilities.label: Windows source/runtime evidence gates
capabilities.notes: HMS-specific certification layer; real target-PC gate has not been executed.

interpretation.feature_score: Evidence-weighted implementation/parity score, not a benchmark of real throughput.
interpretation.production_score: Penalizes synthetic/static-only evidence. It is intentionally much lower until Windows runtime gates pass.
interpretation.no_superset_claim: HMS must not be called a production superset while Windows/runtime/client compatibility remains uncertified.
